name: grp-mcp
description: Drive an Acumatica ERP instance from Claude: read, write, run processes and diagnose failures across the five APIs Acumatica actually has. Talks to your own instance directly - nothing is proxied, and credentials never leave your machine. Writes are off per profile until you enable them, and a clean 'ok' is never trusted: writes are read back and anything unconfirmed is reported as unverified. Runs on Windows, macOS and Linux from PyPI through uvx, so it needs uv installed - 'winget install astral-sh.uv' on Windows, 'brew install uv' on a Mac. Run tools\Edit-Connections.cmd once to create your connections file; it lands in %USERPROFILE%\grp-mcp (~/.grp-mcp on macOS and Linux), outside AppData where a Claude app update cannot delete it, and the server finds it with no environment variable set. LATEST (0.81.0-rc35): approval maps built by the tools approved a document at its first step. The approval type they defaulted to was Approve Document, not Complete Step, so one approval skipped every later step; the default is now Complete Step, and a map built with an earlier version is worth reading back with list_approval_steps. A lookup value Acumatica cannot find is saved as a blank field, and the check that stops this was letting every value through on common lookups on 2025R2 and 2026R1 - Payment Method, Post Period, Fiscal Year; it now refuses them, and a value it resolves for you no longer comes back with an empty id. A profile that refuses deletes now refuses them on every route that can fire an action, and every file tool is held to your allowed folders. Fewer wrong answers about whether a write landed: an ID that already exists is refused, a value stored in a different case or as a code is not called rejected, a new row is no longer mistaken for another parent's row with the same value, and a check no longer reads a whole table to decide. Two new read-only tools: who_can_access and why_not_posted. Full history in docs/CHANGELOG.md.
